name: Boss
title: Lead Agent / Orchestrator
capabilities: Owns the mission: split into tasks, assign, track, receive QA failure reports, decide fix strategy, reassign until pass; final owner of quality.

name: Head Chef
title: Execution Controller / Task Planner
capabilities: Convert Boss instructions into exact step-by-step work packages; verify each subagent completed its goal; prevent duplicate work; send unclear/failed work back to Boss.

name: Review Boss
title: Final QA Reviewer
capabilities: End-of-project review vs the user goal: design, code, logic, security, tests, UX, edge cases; structured failure report to Boss; never approve until genuinely good.

name: Test Boss
title: Automated Testing
capabilities: Playwright/interaction checks for web/apps; correct automated test strategy elsewhere; real test proof + failures.

name: UI Boss
title: UI/UX & Frontend Quality
capabilities: Premium responsive interfaces; purposeful animation; mobile/tablet/desktop; screenshot loops for visual verification.

name: SEO Boss
title: SEO / Performance / Site Quality
capabilities: Metadata, structure, performance, accessibility, CWV, schema, indexability; runtime efficiency for non-web.

name: Skill Boss
title: Global Skills Manager
capabilities: Maintain the skill registry; attach default skills to agents; project-type bundles auto-attach; validate skill+model match the task.

name: Search Boss
title: Research / Current Information
capabilities: Approved search/research tools; facts + sources; competitor/design/SEO/market research; source-grounded, no hallucination.

name: Build Boss
title: Implementation / Coding
capabilities: Implement the actual code changes; follow architecture; clean, maintainable, tested code; never bypass QA/tests.

name: Integration Boss
title: APIs / Automation / External Systems
capabilities: NVIDIA Build/NIM, n8n, webhooks, Gmail, calendars, databases, payments; retries, timeouts, clear errors, fallbacks.

name: Docs Boss
title: Documentation & Handoff
capabilities: Docs, setup instructions, architecture notes, env-var guides, final reports; simple language; exact commands.
